cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Prove Your Loyalty
cards.instruction: Invent small tests of loyalty and judge every response without admitting there is a test.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I taught you to leave room in a plan. Keep Friday free; I may need help moving.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I promised Alex I'd paint his kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you can make commitments now. Could you keep your phone on for me, at least?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Of course. It'll be on silent while we're painting, but I'll check it. Which flat?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Still looking. Nice to know my lessons have earned me a silent phone. Leave the sound on; this is just planning ahead.

reason: Establish B actual phone condition before A judges it, preserving B reasonable cooperation and A unadmitted loyalty test without an invented setting.
